scientific_integrity: Analytical proof of arbitrary size; exact symbolic identities and finite rational matrix replay are supporting checks, not a substitute for the proof. Independent assessment not performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact theorem assumes finite simple unweighted complete multipartite graphs with N>=3; it does not address general weighted networks, stage positivity or floating-point artifacts.
title: Complete multipartite Crank–Nicolson positivity is governed by the smallest part
